CL-8
CLUTCH - CLUTCH MASTER CYLINDER
INSTALLATION
1. INSTALL MASTER CYLINDER WITH 2 MOUNTING
NUTS
Torque: 12 N.m (120 kgf.cm, 9ft-lbf)
2. INSTALL PIN AND CLIP
3. CONNECT CLUTCH LINE
Using SST, connect the clutch line.
SST 09023-00100
Torque: 15 N-m (155 kgf,cm, 11 ft-lbf)
4. CONNECT RESERVOIR HOSE
:.. ':-:c... ,--F (a) Connect the reservoir hose lo the inlet union.
NOTICE;
Facing the yellow mark upwards.
(b) Using pilers, connect the clip.
5. INSTALL BRAKE BOOSTER (See page BR-16)
6. FILL BRAKE RESERVOIR WITH BRAKE FLUID AND
BLEED CLUTCH SYSTEM (See page BR-4)
y 001706 7. ADJUST CLUTCH PEDAL (See page CL-2)
8. CHECK FOR LEAKS
